I wrote the answer to `answer.json`: 17 def-use pairs that I expect to appear in all 10 tests. I got them by reading the code and tracing it by hand, since nothing could be run here.

All 10 tests have the same structure and differ only in the seed number, so every call takes the same path through `subtract` (`src/pybamm/expression_tree/binary_operators.py`). That path ends at line 1077 (`return left.left`), which handles the `(b + a) - a` case:

- **Parameters (defined at 1015):** `left` and `right` are each read once, at 1026, where both are immediately reassigned.
- **`left` (defined at 1026):** read at 1034, 1039, 1042, 1058, 1062, 1069, 1074, 1075 and 1077.
- **`right` (defined at 1026):** read at 1030, 1034, 1062, 1066 and 1075.
- **`out` (defined at 1034):** read at 1035. The helper returns nothing here, so the function carries on.
- **Never read on this path:** `r_left`, `r_right`, `left_dim_size` and `right_dim_size`.

Two things depend on `and` stopping early. The right-hand side isn't a constant, so line 1030 never reads `left`. The left-hand side isn't a constant either, so line 1058 never reads `right`. I also assumed `_simplify_elementwise_binary_broadcasts` hands back the same two expressions, because none of them are broadcasts.
